title: check says when only the roadmap render is stale, as after a merge
lead: When the only stale render files are the whole-roadmap ones and every slice render is current, `check` says that this is what a merge leaves and that `slicer render` (or the landing's `done --render`) regenerates them.
findings_note: outer-session wishlist 2026-10-16, item 4: every landing left check failing on a stale ROADMAP render
boundary: **Not in this slice:** changing the merge driver; rendering during a merge; git hooks.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Every landing from s296 to s308 on 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 ended its main-branch suite run with `check` failing on `stale render: ROADMAP.html` and `ROADMAP.md`. The cause is by design: the `slicer-generated` merge driver keeps the current branch's generated files (S109, `cli.py:727-728`), so a merge leaves the roadmap render behind the merged index until the next render. The generic line `check failed; run slicer render and slicer sync, then re-run` (`cli.py:3084`) does not say that this is expected, so each landing needed a careful read to tell this case from real drift.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `src/slicer/cli.py`, `_check_report` and the failure line at `cli.py:3084`: when every stale path is a whole-roadmap render (`render.ROADMAP_FILES` or the equivalent list the renderer owns), with no stale slice render, no orphan, no stale sync and no problems, add the line `only the roadmap render is stale, as a merge leaves it (the slicer-generated driver keeps one side); run slicer render, or done --render when landing`. The exit code stays 1.
- `--json`: `check` adds `"stale_render_kind": "roadmap_only"` in that case and `"mixed"` or absent otherwise. This is additive.
- `docs/landing.md`: one sentence after the merge step saying `check` fails this way until `done --render` runs.
- `docs/agents.md` (the `check` payload), `CHANGELOG.md` under Changed.
- `tests/test_check.py`.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the tests and watch them go red.
2. Classify the stale paths; add the line and the JSON key.
3. Docs and CHANGELOG; mutation-check (always print the hint; never print it).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body: - `python3.12 tests/affected.py --run`, then the full suite. `slicer check` passes.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch; the owner lands it.
